sections.content: Window functions compute across rows related to the current row WITHOUT collapsing groups like aggregates — ROW_NUMBER, RANK, LAG, LEAD, running SUMs.
OVER (PARTITION BY dept ORDER BY salary) defines the window. They rank top-N per group, compute moving averages, and fill gaps — all in one pass.
Key points: they run after WHERE/GROUP BY, cannot nest window functions, and ROW_NUMBER vs RANK differ on ties (RANK skips positions).
Try this variation — change a value, predict the output, then run it:
sections.codeExample:
SELECT name, salary,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY dept ORDER BY salary DESC) AS rank
FROM employees;
-- experiment: modify a value above and predict the new output
